verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an agentic video-production app, but the evidence shows no user-definable rule or trigger system. The closest items are built-in pipeline behaviors: each finished shot is automatically sent to a reviewer agent, and jobs pause and resume when a limit is hit. There is also a one-off scheduled post command (`--at`), which is a single timed action rather than a rule that fires on events. None of these is a user-defined rule that triggers actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
